accepted_mathematical_interfaces: The source CptCoef and FormLimit require exactly smoothness on the original unitary group, bounded Frobenius support and a common positive Gram cutoff. The actual cutoff has uniformly bounded invariant derivatives, and one unit of fixed decay gives convergence in each required finite derivative norm; no growth of the decay exponent with derivative order is assumed.

Complete-head-block Cramer formulas recover L, B, U and their inverses without dividing by internal minors. Radical inverse formulas recover the actual slice coordinates and residual gamma with polynomial degree at most 4(r+1). Residual differentiation conjugates only by the radical matrices, because the head flag matrices commute with the residual subgroup. The stated 4jm derivative cost is therefore sufficient.

The original tail-first signed quantum-minor words have order at most length times j and numerator degree at most length times (j+j^2). Fixed-head determinants are the only lower denominators. Combining this with Gram-cutoff derivatives gives the exact lower slice budget; the original residual form has order at most d times length and polynomial degree at most twice length.

Terminal flag stripping has degree at most 4R(R+1)+1, bounded by 9R^2. For Euclidean orthonormal Q in the positive complement, Q*J is a coisometry and hence norm((Q*JQ)^-1)=norm(Pi). This bounds every isometry with the prescribed paired-frame action, including every actual fibre representative. The two pointwise flag factors cost respectively M(g0) and M(g0)^2, and their radical coordinates cost at most M(g)^(36R^2), within the 64R^2 allowance.

The existing root-coordinate decomposition retains the original discarded-root stabilizer measure, compact Haar factors and phases. A coefficient-independent normalized cut, obtained from an integral-one bump in the discarded roots, combined with Tonelli and the new absolute bound opens the actual orbJ existence branch for noncompact finite-decay coefficients. Thus no prior FormLimit is assumed in identifying that integral.

BigCellVanishingOfCommute96–103 permits only the terminal determinant and Gram denominator when L is empty; both are bounded away from zero on the original Gram cutoff. FibBound92–94 charges 3R for each derivative already present in a fibre factor. Together with 2R per Gram-cutoff derivative this gives kappa+5Ro, with the original total derivative allowance o retained.

The symbolic budget certificates verify Cc=10000(1+abs(Cb))^2 for all r>=0,k>=2,N>=0. All other constants may depend on the fixed head, place, word and coefficient type. Thus Cc has exactly the required dependence only on Cb.

The original RRplace definition makes invalid heads and levels above r+1 zero. Positive terminal heads use actual orbital-vector convergence, including original dH factors and finite type projections; the empty word uses its separate direct Hilbert–Schmidt pairing. Lower heads are pointwise limits of the original slices and forms, not almost-everywhere representatives.
